name: Prehistoric Sites of the Khorramabad Valley
description: In the Zagros Mountains of western Iran, near the city of Khorramabad, five caves and a rock shelter line a narrow, well-watered valley. Early humans sheltered here as far back as 63,000 years ago, leaving behind finely made stone tools and decorative objects. Much of the valley is still unexcavated, so more clues to early human migration out of Africa may yet emerge.
